definition: Start with shared audit defaults from internal/compliance/policy_rule_extensions.yaml.
Apply mode-specific defaults for cel, query, graph, or manual policies.
Apply the domain block keyed by the policy folder under policies/.
Apply any explicit policy ID override when a rule needs different audit language.
Use each PolicyFindingRule YAML file for controls, tags, severity, resource, remediation, risk categories, and MITRE references.
Use internal/findings/public_detection_catalog.json for all public finding types, including non-policy detections.
Derive framework:, control:, and control-family: tags from control_refs for spreadsheet review. These do not replace runtime finding tags.
Generate CSV rows from YAML, the public catalog, and derived review layers. Do not edit spreadsheet rows back into source by hand.
